description: This file declares functions, macros, and external variables related to handling mail mapping (likely for email address normalization or rewriting) in a Git-related project. It defines interfaces for reading mail map data from files or blobs, clearing the mail map, and mapping user information based on the mail mapping.

methods.name: read_mailmap_file
methods.description: Reads mail mapping data from a specified file with given flags, populating the provided string_list.

methods.name: read_mailmap_blob
methods.description: Reads mail mapping data from a blob, populating the provided string_list.

methods.name: read_mailmap
methods.description: Reads mail mapping data, possibly from a default source, populating the string_list.

methods.name: clear_mailmap
methods.description: Clears the mail mapping data in the given string_list.

methods.name: map_user
methods.description: Maps user email and name information according to the mailmap, updating the provided buffers.
